headline: Pedro Sánchez proposes a tax on fortunes of more than 100 million euros
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez proposed a new tax on fortunes above €100 million, a few days before Sunday's general election.
why: Wealth taxes affect high-net-worth individuals and can influence investment and capital flows in the country that adopts them.
original_headline: Pedro Sánchez propone un impuesto para las fortunas de más de 100 millones de euros
